verses.autre-yaman-yara-mafi-damiri-c1-v1: yā man yarā mā fī ḍ-ḍamīri wayasmaʿu ʾanta l-muʿaddu likulli mā yutawaqqaʿu
verses.autre-yaman-yara-mafi-damiri-c1-v2: yā man yurajjā lish-shadāʾidi kullihā yā man ʾilayhi l-mushtakā wal-mafzaʿu
verses.autre-yaman-yara-mafi-damiri-c1-v3: yā man khazāʾinu rizqihi fī qawli kun umnun faʾinna l-khayra ʿindaka ʾajmaʿu
verses.autre-yaman-yara-mafi-damiri-c1-v4: mā lī siwā faqrī ʾilayka wasīlatu wabīlīftiqāri ʾilayka faqrī ʾadfaʿu
verses.autre-yaman-yara-mafi-damiri-c1-v5: mā lī siwā qarʿī libābika ḥīlatu falaʾin ṭuridtu faʾayyā bābi ʾaqraʿu
verses.autre-yaman-yara-mafi-damiri-c1-v6: wamani lladhī ʾadʿū waʾahtifu bīsmihi ʾin kāna faḍluka ʿan faqīri yumnaʿu
verses.autre-yaman-yara-mafi-damiri-c1-v7: ḥāshā limajdika ʾan tuqanniṭa ʿāṣiyā l-faḍlu ʾajzalu wal-mawāhibu ʾawsaʿu
verses.autre-yaman-yara-mafi-damiri-c1-v8: bidh-dhulli qad wāfaytu bābaka ʿālimā ʾanna t-tadhallula ʿinda bābika yanfaʿu
verses.autre-yaman-yara-mafi-damiri-c1-v9: wajaʿaltu muʿtamadī ʿalayka tawakkullā wabasaṭtu kaffī sāʾilā ʾataḍarraʿu
verses.autre-yaman-yara-mafi-damiri-c1-v10: wabiḥḥaqi man ʾaḥbabtahu wabaʿathtahu waʾajabta daʿwata man bihi yatashaffaʿu
verses.autre-yaman-yara-mafi-damiri-c1-v11: ijʿal lanā min kulli ḍayqi makhrajā waṭ-ṭuf binā yā man ʾilayhi l-marjiʿu
verses.autre-yaman-yara-mafi-damiri-c1-v12: thumma ṣ-ṣalātu ʿalā n-nabiyyī wāʾālihi khayri l-khalāʾiqi shāfiʿu wamushaffaʿu
